values.note: $15 a night per single site (reserved or walk-in); recreation.gov's rate table also lists a $5 add-on rate (likely an extra vehicle, not labelled). The group-use campground is a separate recreation.gov facility.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/aspen-grove-campground ('$15 per night (single site)') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10379365/rates (Peak Season 2026-06-19 to 2026-09-20 and first-come seasons: 15, plus a 5 line), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: recreation.gov per-site catalog for 10379365 (catx.py: all 23 sites STANDARD NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 24 sites in 2 loops. recreation.gov gives max vehicle lengths only for the 10 reservable sites: 20-60 ft (three at 45, one each at 50 and 60).

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/aspen-grove-campground ('The campground has 2 loops and 24 campsites') + recreation.gov per-site catalog (catx.py: Max Vehicle Length 20-60 on the reservable sites), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 3 vault toilets, several potable-water spigots, 2 dumpsters; food storage lockers. Grizzly country: the food storage order is enforced.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10379365 ('There are 3 vault toilets that service the campground and 2 dumpsters for trash disposal. Several spigots with potable water', amenities 'Food Storage Locker'; notice 'Visitors must follow the Food Storage Order at all times') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/aspen-grove-campground ('Potable water is available at this site'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: One loop is reservable on recreation.gov (10 sites; 'The reservable loop is to the east of the Host Site'); the other 13 sites are walk-in. 16 nights in a rolling 30 days. Check-in after 2 pm, check-out before 2 pm.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/helena-lewisclark/recreation/aspen-grove-campground ('Reserve a single site at Aspen Grove') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10379365 (directions 'The reservable loop is to the east of the Host Site'; notice 'The stay limit at Aspen Grove is 16 days'; rules maxStay 16 'Rolling 30 Days') + recreation.gov per-site catalog (10 reservable, 13 not), read 2026-10-22

note: Helena-Lewis and Clark NF (Lincoln RD) campground on the upper Blackfoot River, 6.5 miles east of Lincoln off MT-200 then 1/2 mile of gravel. Blackfoot River fishing (cutthroat, rainbow, brown trout, whitefish). Near Continental Divide Trail access at Rogers and Flesher passes; Indian Meadows trailhead into the Scapegoat Wilderness is 10 mi up Copper Creek Road. A separate group-use campground shares the site. --Claude
summary: Forest Service-run (Lincoln RD), one loop reservable on recreation.gov, the rest walk-in. Confirmed $15 (2026), 24 sites, 60-ft max, no electric, vault toilets, potable water, reservable/some FCFS, 16-day limit. Not stated: season dates (only rate seasons), booking window (inherited 180). Note trimmed of restated values.
